description: This PHP class, ApiAuthorizationSubscriber, is an event subscriber within the OrangeHRM framework that handles API authorization by intercepting controller and exception events. It verifies user permissions for API access based on the request method and manages forbidden responses for unauthorized access attempts.

classes.name: ApiAuthorizationSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber class that manages API access permission checks and handles forbidden access responses within the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers event listeners for controller and exception events, assigning priorities.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Checks if the current request's controller has the necessary API permissions; throws ForbiddenException if unauthorized.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles ForbiddenException errors by returning a JSON error response and stopping event propagation.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the controller instance from the event.

methods.name: getPermissionGetterMethod
methods.description: Maps HTTP methods to permission getter method names (e.g., canRead, canCreate).
